sanskrit: śrutaṃ deva mayā jñeyaṃ nirvāṇaṃ paramaṃ ca yat | praveśayet svarūpaṃ tu grahaṇaṃ vistarād vada —
close_translation: [Devī:] "I have heard, O god, the knowable (jñeya), and that supreme nirvāṇa: one should enter the own-form (svarūpa); tell the comprehension (grahaṇa), at length."
provenance: derived from our T1 (working translation, not peer reviewed)

sanskrit: anākhye yasya tatvasya nirguṇasya yaśasvini | guṇavad grahaṇaṃ kṛtvā kathayet parameśvaram —
close_translation: [Bhairava:] "Of that tattva, the Inexplicable (anākhya), the quality-less (nirguṇa), O glorious one: having made the quality-bearing comprehension (guṇavad-grahaṇa), one tells the supreme Lord."
provenance: derived from our T1 (working translation, not peer reviewed)

sanskrit: kiṃcidābhāsamātraṃ tu kṛtvā tu kathayecchivam | prayādhvana * * * ma uccārālaṃvanāni ca —
close_translation: "Having made only a little-illumination (kiṃcid-ābhāsa-mātra), one tells Śiva; [by] the going-the-path * * * [and] the uccāra-reliances (uccārā-ālambana), indeed. *[X: line 2 corrupt in the manuscript — the uccāra/āveśa-register.]*"
provenance: derived from our T1 (working translation, not peer reviewed)

sanskrit: sthātavyaṃ tu varārohe prarityajyamaśeṣata | evaṃ sa nirjitā tiṣṭhe mano durjaya caṃcalaṃ —
close_translation: "One should stand, O fair-thighed one, abandoning everything (aśeṣata); thus, unconquered-by-it, [the] mind, the hard-to-conquer, the restless, stands."
provenance: derived from our T1 (working translation, not peer reviewed)

sanskrit: calatena kadācit sā jñeyāvastho bhavetu sā | anirjitā yathā malla darpāṇi kurute vahuḥ —
close_translation: "By-the-restlessness, sometimes, that [mind] becomes-the-knowable-state (jñeya-avastha). As the unconquered wrestler (malla) makes many prides (darpa) —"
provenance: derived from our T1 (working translation, not peer reviewed)

sanskrit: nirjitastiṣṭhate vīrastathā jñeyamidaṃ manaḥ | na hi gartā bhavet kaścid gatavyaṃ vā na vidyate —
close_translation: "the conquered-vīra stands — thus this mind is-to-be-known. For-there-would-be-no-pit (gartā), nor-is-there-any-thing-to-be-gone (gatavya)."
provenance: derived from our T1 (working translation, not peer reviewed)

sanskrit: gamāgamavinirmuktaṃ ghaṭākāśeva tiṣṭhati | jalamadhya gate kuṃbhe pūrṇe vāhyantagaṃ jalam —
close_translation: "Free-from-the-going-and-coming (gamāgama-vinirmukta), [it] stands like-the-space-in-the-jar (ghaṭākāśa). When the pot (kumbha), gone-into-the-midst-of-the-water, is filled, the water [is] the-external-and-internal (bāhya-anta-ga)."
provenance: derived from our T1 (working translation, not peer reviewed)

sanskrit: nānyastatra vikāraṃ tu kṛtimātravibhāvanā | ghaṭasaṃvṛtamākāśaṃ nīyamānaṃ yatastataḥ —
close_translation: "There-is-not-another-transformation-there, indeed; the mere-fabrication-contemplation (kṛti-mātra-vibhāvanā). The jar-covered-space (ghaṭa-saṃvṛta-ākāśa), being-carried-whence-and-hence (yatastataḥ) —"
provenance: derived from our T1 (working translation, not peer reviewed)

sanskrit: ghaṭo nayati nākāśaṃ tadvajjīvaṃ nabhopamam | kadalī sārdhavadvehaṃ dhṛtaṃ tatvadale sthitam —
close_translation: "the jar carries-not-the-space; likewise-the-life (jīva), the-sky-like (nabhopama). The body (deha), held like-the-banana-stalk (kadalī-sārdha), stands-in-the-tattva-leaf (tatva-dale)."
provenance: derived from our T1 (working translation, not peer reviewed)

sanskrit: tasmāt tatvadalatyāgī vyomaṃ ca bhavate tadā | nirākārātmavijñānaṃ bhāvanāgatacetasaḥ —
close_translation: "Therefore, the-tattva-leaf-abandoner (tatva-dala-tyāgī) becomes-the-sky (vyoma), then, indeed; the-form-less-self-knowledge (nirākāra-ātma-vijñāna), of-the-mind-gone-to-the-bhāvanā (bhāvanā-gata-cetas)."
provenance: derived from our T1 (working translation, not peer reviewed)

sanskrit: mokṣepi yasya notkaṃṭha samokṣamadhigacchati | mokṣo nāma samākhyāto aśarīro nirākṛtiḥ —
close_translation: "Even-in-the-mokṣa, of-him-who-has-not-the-ardor (utkaṇṭhā), one-attains-the-sameness-with-the-mokṣa (sam-okṣa). The-mokṣa-called: the-body-less (aśarīra), the-form-less (nirākṛti) —"
provenance: derived from our T1 (working translation, not peer reviewed)

sanskrit: acintyo nirguṇo mokṣo na tu mokṣo layānvitaḥ | na mokṣa na mokṣasya bhavet sthānaṃ na cādhvānaṃ kadācana
close_translation: "the-unthinkable (acintya), the-quality-less (nirguṇa) mokṣa; but-not-the-mokṣa-joined-with-the-dissolution (laya-anvita). There-is-neither-the-mokṣa, nor-the-mokṣa's-station (sthāna), nor-the-path (adhvāna), ever."
provenance: derived from our T1 (working translation, not peer reviewed)

sanskrit: sarvatra viditā dṛṣṭi samokṣo mokṣavādinām | vahubhirvāhyavairāgyaṃ ātmānirvāpitastu yaiḥ —
close_translation: "Everywhere-the-known-vision (dṛṣṭi) [is] the-sameness-with-the-mokṣa of-the-mokṣa-speakers (mokṣa-vādin); by-many, [by] the-external-dispassion (vāhya-vairāgya), the-self-quenched (ātma-nirvāpita), indeed, by-whom —"
provenance: derived from our T1 (working translation, not peer reviewed)

sanskrit: teṣāmekopi nāstyatra gatāni rūpapattikam | evamanyopi ye keci ni * pyante virāgiṇaḥ —
close_translation: "of-them-not-even-one-is-here, the-gone-to-the-form-getting (rūpa-pattika). Thus, and-the-other, whoever-are-called-the-dispassionate (virāgiṇa): *[X: "ni*pyante" corrupt — likely "nirvāpyante" (are quenched).]*"
provenance: derived from our T1 (working translation, not peer reviewed)

sanskrit: tathātepi ca tiṣṭhanti nirvāṇaṃ prathamaṃ yathā | * *? śilādhvataṃteyaṃ kṣapitaṃ sūryaraśmibhiḥ —
close_translation: "they, too, stand thus, like-the-first-nirvāṇa; [as] the-stone-at-the-mountain's-end(*), worn-away-by-the-sun's-rays (sūryaraśmi). *[X: "* *? śilādhvataṃteyaṃ" corrupt.]*"
provenance: derived from our T1 (working translation, not peer reviewed)

sanskrit: tathā nirvāpito hyātmā gato nirayapattikam | na tatroyaṃ gato bhūmyāṃ na ca tatraiva tiṣṭhati —
close_translation: "Thus, indeed, the-quenched-self (nirvāpita-ātman) [is] the-gone-to-the-inferior-getting (niraya-pattika); not-this-one-gone-to-the-earth, nor-does-he-stand-there-itself."
provenance: derived from our T1 (working translation, not peer reviewed)

sanskrit: na ca kenacit pītaṃgaro nirūpapattikam | evaṃ gṛhya tu vairāgyaṃ yaduktaṃ guruṇā hitam —
close_translation: "Nor-by-anything [is] the-gone-to-the-fruition-less (nirūpa-pattika). Thus, taking-the-dispassion (vairāgya), which-is-said-by-the-guru [as]-the-good (hitam): *[X: "pītaṃgaro" uncertain — likely a compound of the fallen-state.]*"
provenance: derived from our T1 (working translation, not peer reviewed)

sanskrit: tato hyanādayaṃ bhāvaṃ yadyapyekaṃ sanātanam | vāhyā sā mokṣavādīnāṃ yatra sarvakṣayaṃ gataḥ —
close_translation: "Then, indeed, the-beginning-less-being (anādaya-bhāva), although-the-one, the-eternal (sanātana): that-external-view of-the-mokṣa-speakers, where-the-all-destruction (sarva-kṣaya) has-gone."
provenance: derived from our T1 (working translation, not peer reviewed)

sanskrit: etadanyatra vairāgyaṃ api satva sukhāvaham | yannāstistatra dehaṃ prāyaścitte kariṣyate —
close_translation: "This-dispassion-elsewhere, although-existing, the-ease-bringing (sukha-āvaha): what-is-not-there, the-body (deha), in-the-penance (prāyaścitta), one-will-do."
provenance: derived from our T1 (working translation, not peer reviewed)

sanskrit: sāmukto nirvikalpastu savikalpastu vadhyaṃti | nadīnāṃ sāgaraṃ prāpya nānārūpaṃ nivartate —
close_translation: "The-said-nirvikalpa (the non-constructive), and-the-savikalpa (the constructive), [they]-are-slain (vadhyante). The-rivers, having-reached-the-ocean, return-in-manifold-form (nānā-rūpa-nivartate)."
provenance: derived from our T1 (working translation, not peer reviewed)

sanskrit: te tatra nābhi jānaṃti paraspara viśeṣaṇam | na cānye jāyate tatra udake tu viśeṣaṇam —
close_translation: "They, there, do-not-know-the-mutual-difference (paraspara-viśeṣaṇa); nor-are-others-born-there, the-difference-in-the-water, indeed."
provenance: derived from our T1 (working translation, not peer reviewed)

sanskrit: tatra kṣayaṃ gatā nadyastathāpyeka mahodadhiḥ | evaṃ nadyopamaṃ dehaṃ nirvāṇaṃ sādhanopamam —
close_translation: "There, the-rivers-gone-to-destruction, and-thus-the-one-great-ocean (mahodadhi): thus-the-river-like-body (nadyopama-deha), the-nirvāṇa, the-means-like (sādhanopama)."
provenance: derived from our T1 (working translation, not peer reviewed)

sanskrit: nirddaṃdaṃstiṣṭhataste vai sāgarāsṛta siṃdhavaḥ | tiṣṭhate niścalatvaṃ hi tṛptitvaṃ tasya jāte —
close_translation: "The-unstinging (nir-daṃda), they-stand, indeed, the-rivers-having-taken-refuge-in-the-ocean; the-motionlessness (niścalatva) stands, indeed, [and]-the-satisfaction (tṛpti) of-that-is-born."
provenance: derived from our T1 (working translation, not peer reviewed)

sanskrit: sukhaṃ duḥkhaṃ na saṃvetti gṛhnāti śivatāṃguṇān | abhāve bhāvanā yacca bhāvaṃ kṛtvā nirāśrayam —
close_translation: "Ease-and-unease-one-does-not-perceive; one-takes-the-Śiva's-qualities (śivatā-guṇa). In-the-absence (abhāve), the-bhāvanā; and-that, having-made-the-being (bhāva) the-support-less (nirāśraya) —"
provenance: derived from our T1 (working translation, not peer reviewed)

sanskrit: ātmasaṃsthaṃ manaḥ kṛtvā na kiṃcidapi cittayet | abhāve bhāvanā bhāve bhāvalīnamasaṃkitaḥ —
close_translation: "having-made-the-mind-the-self-stationed (ātma-saṃstha), one-should-not-think-anything (kiṃcid-api-cittayet). In-the-absence, the-bhāvanā; in-the-being, the-being-dissolved (bhāva-līna), the-unfrightened (asaṃkita) —"
provenance: derived from our T1 (working translation, not peer reviewed)

sanskrit: vibhuritti samaṃtavyo nātra kārya vicāraṇāt | abhāvasya kṛto bhāvo niṣkalasya kuto manaḥ —
close_translation: "'the-lord (vibhu)', thus-one-should-consider; here-no-deliberation-of-the-work (kārya-vicāraṇā). Of-the-absence, the-made-being (kṛto-bhāva); of-the-quality-less (niṣkala), whence-the-mind (kuto-manaḥ)?"
provenance: derived from our T1 (working translation, not peer reviewed)

sanskrit: amane yadyavasthānaṃ nirvāṇaṃ tasya tatpadam | tasya jāgre pralīyante sarve bhāvāsu guptavat —
close_translation: "In-the-mind-less (amana), if-the-abiding (avasthāna): that-nirvāṇa [is]-his-station (tat-padam). Of-him, in-the-waking (jāgre), all-the-beings (bhāvāḥ)-dissolve, like-the-hidden (guptavat)."
provenance: derived from our T1 (working translation, not peer reviewed)

sanskrit: paryāptaṃ tasya vijñānaṃ tṛpadaṃ tena lāṃghitam | pūrako hyakṣarojñeya surecitamanakṣaram —

provenance: derived from our T1 (working translation, not peer reviewed)

sanskrit: kuṃbhakena sa jñeyaṃ kṣarākṣaraparaḥ śivaḥ | sarvaṃ tyaktvā samādhistho antaḥkaraṇa gocaraḥ —

provenance: derived from our T1 (working translation, not peer reviewed)

provenance: derived from our T1 (working translation, not peer reviewed)

sanskrit: savāhyābhyantare saiva anādi śivamavyayam —

provenance: derived from our T1 (working translation, not peer reviewed)

sanskrit: abhāve bhāvamādāya na mayā jñātavyaṃ haraḥ | akṣarākṣarayorevaṃ vibhāgaṃ parameśvara —
close_translation: [Devī:] "In-the-absence, taking-the-being (bhāva-ādāya), this-has-not-been-known-by-me, O-Hara: [and] the-difference-of-the-perishable-and-unperishable (akṣarākṣara), thus, O-supreme-Lord —"
provenance: derived from our T1 (working translation, not peer reviewed)

sanskrit: yena vijñānamātreṇa mucyantiravikalpanāḥ | viśanti samanya tasya śivatatvasya śūlinā —
close_translation: "by-which, by-the-knowledge-alone (vijñāna-mātra), they-are-released, the-non-constructive (avikalpanāḥ); [and]-enter-the-sameness (samatā) of-that-Śiva-tattva, O-trident-holder (śūlin)."

close_translation: [Bhairava:] "By-the-quality-less (niṣkala), O-fair-thighed-one, without-effort (akleśena), indeed, one-succeeds. Having-known-the-threefold-broken-state (bhinnāvastha-tridhā), one-does-not-again-attain-the-birth (janma)."
provenance: derived from our T1 (working translation, not peer reviewed)

sanskrit: sṛṣṭinyāyena siddhyarthaṃ saṃhāre mokṣameva ca | utpatti pralayaṃ jñātvā siddhyate nā saṃśayaḥ —
close_translation: "By-the-creation-order (sṛṣṭi-nyāya), for-the-siddhi; in-the-dissolution (saṃhāre), the-mokṣa, indeed. Having-known-the-origination-and-dissolution (utpatti-pralaya), one-succeeds — no-doubt."
provenance: derived from our T1 (working translation, not peer reviewed)

close_translation: [Devī:] "The-origination-and-the-dissolution, and-the-going-and-coming (āgati-gati) of-the-beings (bhūtānāṃ): this-I-wish-to-know, O-Bhagavan; you-are-worthy-to-tell."
provenance: derived from our T1 (working translation, not peer reviewed)

close_translation: [Bhairava:] "The-origination-and-the-dissolution, indeed — this [is]-the-great-topic (prastava): that-I-will-tell, O-Devī, for-your-delight, O-fair-faced-one."
provenance: derived from our T1 (working translation, not peer reviewed)

provenance: derived from our T1 (working translation, not peer reviewed)

provenance: derived from our T1 (working translation, not peer reviewed)
